set.per_unit_cap: Exemption is the share of value equal to the share of units serving lower income households. Revenue and Taxation Code 214(g)(1)(C) caps the exemption at $20,000,000 of assessed value per taxpayer only for claims based solely on occupancy (90% or more of occupants lower income at Health and Safety Code 50053 rents) and not by a limited partnership with an eligible nonprofit managing general partner; projects with bond, government loan or grant financing under regulatory agreements (214(g)(1)(A)) or tax credits (214(g)(1)(B)) are not subject to the cap.
set.audit_note: Tier 4 spot check Nov 9, 2026: OC Assessor Institutional Exemptions page is general (no low-income housing detail); BOE Publication 149 confirms BOE-267 filing by February 15 and partial exemption for late claims. The record misdescribed who is subject to the $20 million cap. Prevailing wage false is uncited.

reason: Material: per_unit_cap described the 214(g) $20 million cap as applying to MGP-qualified LPs, but the statute excludes those and caps only occupancy-based claims.
